stage: before any matched-budget method outcomes are available
clarification: Permute all ten electrode features jointly within each inner-held-out participant; score by equally weighted participant Macro-F1. This preserves person identity and within-electrode feature dependence. Both methods share the same fitted model and equal-person validation samples.
training_sampling: Uniform capped sampling with seed20260728+fold; validation uses a separate deterministic random generator to avoid method-dependent fitting samples.
comparison_scope: This new controlled probe uses 2000 validation windows per fold and grouped permutation. It does not retroactively equate its protocols with the earlier single-model featurewise permutation baseline.
